title: cordylanthus parviflorus
intro: Cordylanthus parviflorus, commonly known as the dwarf mountain-madrona, is a perennial plant species native to the western United States. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Cordylanthus parviflorus include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it useful for treating respiratory issues and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
